name: Uzzi
overview: Uzzi was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, known specifically as the son of Bela. His identity is primarily established through his lineage in the tribe of Benjamin, as recorded in Scripture. There are no additional notes or unique distinguishing details beyond his paternal connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Uzzi means 'YHWH is [my] strength,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that acknowledges God's empowering presence. This proper name is not indicated as being given directly by God, but it carries a profound declaration of reliance on the Lord.
familyAndRelationships: Uzzi is explicitly identified as the son of Bela, establishing his place within the Benjaminite lineage. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Uzzi's significance in the biblical narrative lies in his role as a descendant of Bela within the tribe of Benjamin, contributing to the genealogical record that preserves the heritage and identity of God's people. His mention underscores the faithfulness of God in maintaining the tribes of Israel through successive generations.
